The diagram shows component placement and screw operations, but gives no explicit torque, duration, or exhaustive prerequisite specification. Component state 1 refers to correct assembly of that component at the stated time, not completion of the whole device. The ordered stages may be used to compare the observed sequence with this supplied guide; a difference alone must not be called an operator error.
